founders.metaDescription: SIAPP is a members club for Lisbon nightlife. Pre-register before the doors open and lock in the founder deal — for good.
founders.tagline: but the first ones in get the founder deal — forever.
founders.introBody: is a members club for Lisbon nightlife. Pay one membership, get <keys>keys</keys> every month, spend them on free or discounted tickets at the city's best events & nightlife affairs. Pre-register now and your membership terms are locked at the founder deal for as long as you stay a member. After launch, nobody gets it.
founders.perk1Body: the best terms we'll ever offer, fixed for as long as you stay a member. never on sale again.
founders.perk2Body: you're invited to create your account before the public launch — and before the private sales open.
founders.perk3Body: one email when we open. nothing to pay today, nothing to cancel.
founders.formTagline: takes ten seconds. we'll do the rest.
founders.unsubscribed: you're off the list. the door's still here if you change your mind.
founders.consent: contact me when SIAPP opens and keep my founder deal. see the <privacy>privacy notice</privacy>.
founders.small: no payment today. one email when we open. unsubscribe any time.
founders.step1Body: leave your email. you get a founder number and a confirmation — that's it.
founders.step2Body: Lisbon first. you get the invitation before anyone else, with the founder deal already applied.
founders.step3BodyA: every month your membership gives you
founders.step3BodyB: keys. spend them on free or discounted entry at partner parties. show the QR at the door. you're in.

founderEmails.welcomePreheader: Founder #{number} — your founder deal is locked.
founderEmails.welcomeP1: You're founder #{number} on the SIAPP list. The doors in Lisbon aren't open yet; when they are, you hear it first.
founderEmails.welcomeP2: The founder deal is yours for keeps: the best membership terms we will ever offer, locked for as long as you stay a member. It never goes on sale again after launch.
founderEmails.welcomeP3: We'll email you once, with your invitation to create your account. Nothing else until then.
founderEmails.welcomeFootnote: Not you, or changed your mind? Unsubscribe here and we delete the lead: {url}
founderEmails.footer: You're receiving this once because you pre-registered at {url}.
founderEmails.inviteTagline: the doors are open. you're first.
founderEmails.invitePreheader: Your invitation to create your SIAPP account — founder deal included.
founderEmails.inviteP1: You pre-registered as founder #{number}. SIAPP is now open in Lisbon, and this is your invitation to create your account before everyone else.
founderEmails.inviteP2: Use the button below and sign in with {email} — the same address you registered with. That's what ties the founder deal to your account: our best membership terms, locked for as long as you stay a member.
founderEmails.inviteP3: Pick a plan, get your keys, spend them on free or discounted entry at partner parties. Show the QR at the door. You're in.
founderEmails.inviteFootnote: Not interested after all? Unsubscribe here: {url}
